components.name: Store-name search
components.description: Root searches all store names; category pages search only their stores. Runtime adds clear action, polite result count and distinct empty states.
components.css: .ds-search{max-width:720px;font-family:"Plus Jakarta Sans",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#111)}.ds-search label{display:block;font-family:"Space Grotesk",Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-field{position:relative}.ds-field>svg{position:absolute;left:20px;top:20px;width:24px;height:24px;color:var(--primary,#a04100);pointer-events:none}.ds-field input{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;height:64px;padding:16px 64px 16px 56px;font:inherit;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#111);border:1px solid var(--border,#e8e4de);border-radius:8px;caret-color:var(--primary,#a04100)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,rgba(17,17,17,.70))}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--orange,#ff6b00);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: The supplied Wakil AI design system governs this white-first, warm directory with geometric typography and purposeful orange accents. This records the implemented CSS subset, without a separate visual comp. Scope is the English root and eleven category pages; individual store pages retain local brands and French copy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm white canvas, white cards and delicate borders.
Self-hosted Space Grotesk headings/navigation and Plus Jakarta Sans body.
SVG category icons, proportioned store logos and whole-card navigation.

rules.name: The White-First Rule
rules.body: Warmth comes from the canvas and orange accents, without stacking decorative beige layers.

dos: Do apply the shared system only to directory pages.
Do preserve supplied logos and visible keyboard focus.
Do let content wrap and scroll naturally.
donts: Don't propagate directory branding into store pages.
Don't crop, recolor or fabricate logos or location facts.
Don't add shadows or motion absent from the implementation.
